name: NeuroScale Ops — K8s Incident Response
description: AI-powered Kubernetes incident response orchestrated by UiPath Maestro. Detects cluster anomalies, performs AI triage, evaluates cost impact, obtains human approval, executes remediation via ArgoCD, and generates post-mortem documentation.
author: Sodiq Jimoh — NeuroScale Ops

stages.name: Incident Detection
stages.description: Detector Agent continuously monitors the K8s cluster. Emits a structured Alert on OOMKill, CrashLoop, PolicyViolation, CostSpike, or DeploymentFailure.

stages.name: AI Triage
stages.description: Triage Agent (Groq llama-3.3-70b-versatile) performs root cause analysis, matches runbook, calculates confidence score.

stages.name: Cost Impact Analysis
stages.description: Cost Agent queries OpenCost for namespace-level spend, calculates remediation cost delta, assesses budget utilisation.

stages.name: Human Approval
stages.description: UiPath Apps form presented to SRE/on-call engineer showing triage report, cost impact, and AI reasoning. Human approves or rejects the proposed remediation action.

stages.name: Execute Remediation
stages.description: Remediation Agent executes the approved action: kubectl patch, ArgoCD rollback, scale-down, or Kyverno exception creation. Circuit breaker prevents runaway loops.

stages.name: Remediation Signoff
stages.description: Engineer confirms the remediation resolved the incident. Final signoff before case closure.

stages.name: Post-Mortem & Documentation
stages.description: UiPath Document Understanding generates a structured post-mortem PDF summarising the incident timeline, root cause, actions taken, cost impact, and preventive recommendations.
